content.value_statement: ISMS teams must plan audits, assess controls, and prepare evidence across many security domains. This skill provides structured ISO 27001 audit guidance, control review prompts, and reporting support.
actual_capabilities: Build risk-based ISMS audit plans with scope, frequency, and priority guidance.
Guide ISO 27001 audit preparation, execution, documentation, and follow-up activities.
Assess administrative, technical, physical, and operational security controls.
Support cloud security, regulatory compliance, and certification readiness reviews.
Help frame findings, risk impact, corrective actions, and executive reporting.
Identify auditor competency needs and audit program improvement metrics.
limitations: Does not provide legal advice or replace accredited certification auditors.
Requires authorized scope before discussing vulnerability scans, penetration tests, or simulations.
The included script, reference, and asset files are placeholders, not working audit tools.
Cannot verify evidence quality without user-provided documents, systems, and audit context.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Internal ISMS Audit
use_cases.description: Create a risk-based plan, evidence request list, and control testing approach for ISO 27001 processes.

use_cases.title: Assess Security Control Evidence
use_cases.description: Review policies, logs, access records, and technical control evidence against audit objectives.

use_cases.title: Plan Certification Readiness
use_cases.description: Organize gaps, remediation priorities, and stakeholder reporting before Stage 1 or Stage 2 audits.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Audit Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan an ISO 27001 internal ISMS audit. Scope: [scope]. Assets: [assets]. Risks: [risks]. Produce objectives, schedule, evidence requests, and interview topics.

prompt_templates.title: Review Control Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this control evidence for an ISMS audit: [evidence]. Identify strengths, gaps, sampling concerns, and follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Certification Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a certification readiness review for ISO 27001. Include ISMS scope, Statement of Applicability, risk treatment, internal audit results, management review, and open actions.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Audit Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this risk register, incident history, and control performance data: [data]. Design a 12-month ISMS audit program. Include scope logic, sampling approach, testing boundaries, reporting cadence, and follow-up metrics.

output_examples.input: I need an ISO 27001 audit plan for access control and incident response.
output_examples.output: A concise audit plan with objectives, scope, interview groups, evidence requests, sample selection guidance, and a reporting timeline.

output_examples.input: Our access reviews are inconsistent and evidence is incomplete.
output_examples.output: A finding statement that explains the evidence gap, security risk, likely control impact, corrective action, owner, and due date.

output_examples.input: We are preparing for a Stage 1 certification audit.
output_examples.output: A readiness checklist covering ISMS scope, Statement of Applicability, risk treatment, internal audit, management review, and open corrective actions.

best_practices: Confirm authorization, scope, and rules of engagement before any technical testing discussion.
Provide current ISMS scope, risk register, Statement of Applicability, and recent audit results for better guidance.
Ask for evidence requests, sampling criteria, and finding wording in separate steps.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to plan unauthorized scans, phishing, or penetration tests.
Do not treat generated findings as certification decisions without auditor review.
Do not rely on placeholder files as operational audit automation.

faq.question: Can this skill help with ISO 27001 certification audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps prepare evidence, readiness checks, findings, and remediation plans, but it does not replace a certification body.

faq.question: Does it perform vulnerability scanning?
faq.answer: No. It can help define authorized testing scope and review results, but the included files do not implement scanners.

faq.question: Is it suitable for internal audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports internal ISMS audit planning, control testing, reporting, and follow-up.

faq.question: Can it handle cloud security audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes cloud configuration, shared responsibility, monitoring, encryption, and access control review topics.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide scope, risks, assets, controls, evidence samples, audit objectives, and any legal or contractual requirements.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
